zh-CN.name: 行内校验
zh-CN.description: 在用户离开输入框或提交后，把明确错误与对应字段关联。
use_when: 用于解释或比较与当前任务相关的设计选择。
avoid_when: 不要将演示参数当作通用行业标准。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 邮箱字段在离焦时检查格式，错误说明与字段关联，不把空白的初始输入立即标成错误。更正后清除错误。

en.name: Inline Validation
en.description: Associate clear validation feedback with the field on blur or submission.
use_when: Use to explain or compare design choices relevant to the current task.
avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.
en.prompt_template: Validate email format on blur. Associate errors with the field, do not flag an untouched empty field immediately, and clear the error after correction.
